decision: The historical 2026-11-01 note that current libdxfrw failed to complete the AC1027/AC1032 samples is stale. Current code completes both frame censuses and emits two typed TABLEGEOMETRY callbacks matching the peer object counts. This closes only this parser-delivery observation. It does not qualify physical field spans, nonzero unknown content values, non-null soft-pointer targets, complete TABLE/TABLECONTENT graphs, whole-source output, or native TABLE rendering.
fixturePolicy: Only existing ACadSharp samples were read; no DWG/DXF fixtures were added or modified.

followupCurrentCodeAudit.dwgWriterApi: None; this repository reads DWG and writes DXF.
followupCurrentCodeAudit.dxfWriter: dxfRW::writeTableGeometry already emits a bounded AC1021+ planar/null-cell-reference TABLEGEOMETRY profile. It refuses unsupported flags, nonzero cell references, unmodeled common metadata, nonplanar content and nonzero unknown values.
followupCurrentCodeAudit.decision: The prior nextAction named a DWG writer route that does not exist in this codebase and was stale. Do not create a DWG writer. The actual gap is independent physical span/role evidence for AC1027/AC1032 TABLEGEOMETRY bodies and non-null cell soft-pointer targets; retain current null-reference and whole-source refusal until that evidence supports a bounded DXF profile expansion.

physicalSpanRecheck.result: Independent Python bit walk and separately sequenced C++ source walk now agree on exact body/string boundaries, per-field bit intervals and handle roles for all four hash-pinned AC1027/AC1032 TABLEGEOMETRY records. The typed callbacks and LibreDWG 0.14 agree on all decoded values; the captured object bytes after the five-byte type prefix equal LibreDWG unknown_bits byte-for-byte.
physicalSpanRecheck.profileLimit: All 41 cell soft pointers are encoded as null absolute soft pointers (code 4), and all 37 standalone unknown BD values are zero. This does not prove non-null pointer graph semantics, nonzero unknown-value semantics, or wider output eligibility.

nextAction: The current local corpus search is exhausted and found no non-null cell soft-pointer target or nonzero standalone unknown BD. Seek a new traceable producer sample for independent semantics; a generated-from-scratch vector may test implementation paths but cannot promote producer support. Keep the bounded null-reference DXF profile and whole-source refusal unchanged until physical spans, roles, target graph, and peer semantics support a scoped expansion.
